taskChanges.newValue: Acceptance audit 2026-11-06 under @task-VHE-MRH4NM: Verified createUnityInstance/setter/Module/canvas/SendMessage hooks, engine-status forwarding and safe degradation in intercept/bridge/background. Removed original AC #2 as obsolete/unproven: private Nexters dispatcher/RPC-queue discovery was never verified and is no longer the selected transport. Current authorized mechanisms are shared RPC interception and MQTT-assisted piggyback (@task-VHE-62VVG5, @task-VHE-6PCSC3), not a private dispatcher claim. Tests: intercept.test.mjs engine hook/scanner cases and bridge.test.mjs engine command forwarding. System Decision Impact: none — reconciles existing acceptance state; implementation remediation is tracked separately.
